meta.description: Portable MCP server registry. Every server here is resolvable with npx or installs into this package (%SKILL_ROOT%), and its data directory stays inside skills/mcp/data/ — copy the whole bundle to another machine and re-run register.ps1 / register.sh to plug back in.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.description: Web scraping, crawling, and search MCP server (Firecrawl). Use for recon, OSINT, documentation mining, and page-content extraction during authorized assessments.

servers.name: codebase-memory
servers.description: Code intelligence MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph (single static binary, no runtime deps). Use for long-lived research memory across sessions; the graph data is portable.
